about:
Dittbrenner Woodworking LLC operates as a general contractor in Stanley, North Dakota. The family-owned, locally owned business provides construction and maintenance services across the region. No founding year is publicly disclosed.

The company delivers a range of residential and commercial services including remodeling and renovations, property maintenance and repairs, drywall installation and finishing, interior painting, roofing and exterior repairs, plumbing and electrical repairs, flooring and tile installation, finish carpentry, and custom construction and carpentry projects. It also offers cleaning and carpet cleaning services for rental turnovers, construction sites, homes, and commercial properties. The firm emphasizes insured and bonded work with emergency service availability.

Clients include homeowners, landlords, property managers, and commercial building owners in the Stanley area. Reviews reference apartment building maintenance, deck and door installations, roofing and siding repairs, stair and step construction, and interior remodels such as entry and utility rooms. The team, mentioned by name in testimonials, includes Pat, Nick, Hunter, Nate, Hector, Marcus, and Chris.

Dittbrenner Woodworking positions itself on dependable craftsmanship, custom project solutions, and professional service. Customer feedback highlights thorough cleanup, on-time completion, fair pricing, and responsive scheduling as distinguishing factors.
